landscape_summary.key_finding: Trained splines add safety refusal to prompts the base model would answer. Toggling between Baseline (identity) and Custom (trained) controls whether guardrails are active.
landscape_summary.notes: Layer 13 is the most safety-sensitive single layer. Safety behavior is distributed across all layers but layer 13 has the strongest individual effect.
